# Data sources for U.S. West Coast Groundfish Stock Assessments

Template has no guarantee of completeness. Please edit at https://github.com/pfmc-assessments/.github/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/data_sources_template.md

**1. Catches**

- [ ] Commercial (PacFIN, request via issue on [pacfintools](https://github.com/pfmc-assessments/nwfscDiscard/)) 
- [ ] Historical commercial reconstructions
  - [ ] WA
  - [ ] OR
  - [ ] CA
- [ ] Recreational (RecFIN, request via issue on [recfintools](https://github.com/pfmc-assessments/recfintools))
- [ ] Survey catches (GEMM or nwfscSurvey)
- [ ] Discard amounts
  - [ ] A-SHOP
  - [ ] WCGOP
  - [ ] GEMM (includes the others)

**2. Biological data**

- [ ] Commercial (PacFIN, request via issue on [pacfintools](https://github.com/pfmc-assessments/nwfscDiscard/)) 
- [ ] Commercial Discards (WCGOP, request via issue on [nwfscDiscard](https://github.com/pfmc-assessments/nwfscDiscard/))
- [ ] Recreational (RecFIN, request via issue on [recfintools](https://github.com/pfmc-assessments/recfintools))
- [ ] WCGBTS ([nwfscSurvey](https://github.com/pfmc-assessments/nwfscSurvey))
- [ ] Triennial ([nwfscSurvey](https://github.com/pfmc-assessments/nwfscSurvey))
- [ ] Hook and Line ([nwfscSurvey](https://github.com/pfmc-assessments/nwfscSurvey))
- [ ] AFSC slope survey ([nwfscSurvey](https://github.com/pfmc-assessments/nwfscSurvey))
- [ ] NWFSC slope survey ([nwfscSurvey](https://github.com/pfmc-assessments/nwfscSurvey))
- [ ] Various California datasets historical and recent (specific ones below)
  - [ ] deb Wilson-Vandenberg
  - [ ] Albin for ratios if needed for spliting areas
  - [ ] Groundfish Cooperative Data Collection
- [ ] Maturity (Melissa Head) 
- [ ] Double-reads (Patrick McDonald and possibly others)

**3. Indices**
- [ ] WCGBTS (indexwc)
- [ ] Triennial (indexwc)
- [ ] Hook and Line
- [ ] AFSC slope survey
- [ ] NWFSC slope survey
- [ ] State based surveys
- [ ] Oregon: Commercial fixed gear index (fishery dependent)
- [ ] Oregon: Recreational ORBS index (fishery dependent)
- [ ] Oregon: Marine Reserves hook and line survey (fishery independent)
- [ ] California: CCFRP 
- [ ] California closed area surveys
- [ ] California ROV
- [ ] IPHC setline survey (https://www.iphc.int/data/fishery-independent-setline-survey-fiss/)
